dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to have a keen interest in food.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Keen interest? Hmm... I wouldn't go that far... I just need to eat to live!

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: I spend every last Mora I make on food; adding in some wild vegetables and the occasional show of support from a kind hunter, I still end each day feeling like there hasn't quite been enough to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: And then as soon as I start working, I get even more hungry...
